description: The plot illustrates the relationship between Average Lagging (AL) and BLEU score for four different models. The x-axis represents Average Lagging (AL) with a linear scale, ranging from 2.5 to 11.25, and tick labels at intervals of 2.5. The y-axis represents BLEU score, also with a linear scale, ranging from 25 to 33, and tick labels at intervals of 1. The four lines in the plot represent different models: Consistency-CE (purple dashed line with circle markers), Inconsistency-CE (magenta dashed line with square markers), Inconsistency-CE-MP (blue dashed line with square markers), and Consistency-Bi (red solid line with star markers). The Consistency-CE line starts at approximately 26.1 BLEU at an AL of 2.5 and increases to around 31.7 BLEU at an AL of 11.25. The Inconsistency-CE line begins at about 26.2 BLEU at an AL of 2.5 and rises to approximately 31.6 BLEU at an AL of 11.25. The Inconsistency-CE-MP line starts at around 25.5 BLEU at an AL of 2.5, jumps to 28.1 BLEU at an AL of 5.0, and then continues to increase to about 32.0 BLEU at an AL of 11.25. The Consistency-Bi line starts at approximately 28.5 BLEU at an AL of 2.5 and increases to around 32.2 BLEU at an AL of 11.25, with a steady upward trend across the range of AL values.
